comment: Shared by the managed Service tests and the Rust domain and host tests. Each case is the stored files BatteryConfigurationStore.LoadAsync opens; a schema writes the marker for the two documents at that schema. Regenerate the expectations with OPENBLADE_REGENERATE_NATIVE_PROFILE_VECTORS, never by hand.
